title: Scheduled database migration — Object APIs briefly unavailable

updates.message: Maintenance scheduled for May 20, 05:00–05:30 UTC. Object metadata APIs will return 503 during the window.
Investigating elevated 5xx responses from the multi-survey probability service. Other APIs are unaffected.
Backend pods are failing readiness checks after a model artifact rollout. Rolling back.

title: Elevated latency on ZTF Stamps service

updates.message: Stamp retrieval latency above the 3 s degraded threshold. Investigating S3 throttling.
Identified contention on the upstream image archive. Increased connection pool; latency improving but still above target.
Investigating elevated 500 responses on the lightcurve endpoint.
Root cause identified: connection pool exhaustion against the lightcurve DB after a query plan regression.
Resolved. Query plan reverted and connections recycled. Monitoring.
Both services returning connection timeouts. Investigating shared NAT gateway.
Confirmed NAT gateway saturation in the affected AZ. Failing traffic to secondary AZ.
Service restored after failover. Postmortem to follow.
Maintenance window scheduled for April 10, 03:00–04:00 UTC.
